entities.summary: Michel Longtin is a Canadian composer and music educator based in Montreal. An associate of the Canadian Music Centre and a member of the Canadian League of Composers, he won the Jules Léger Prize for New Chamber Music in 1986 for Pohjatuuli. Michel Longtin was a heads of state & government from Montreal (b. 1946-05-20, Montreal). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
